s.how: Steam 400g frozen edamame in their pods for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt, a pinch of chilli flakes and 2 tsp sesame oil. Cut a Lebanese cucumber into batons and pickle for 20 minutes in 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and a pinch of salt, then drain and scatter with toasted sesame seeds. Serve both in small bowls with chopsticks only.
Blanch 2 bunches broccolini for 1 minute and drain. Char in a smoking pan with 2 sliced garlic cloves. Toss with 2 tbsp oyster sauce and a splash of sesame oil. Stand them up in a dish like trees.

m.note: the plate of spaghetti Daniel ends up wearing
m.how: Brown 500g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 700g passata and 1 tsp oregano and simmer 30 minutes. Cook 400g spaghetti, toss with the sauce and serve with 50g grated parmesan and basil.

w.how: Stir 200g glutinous rice flour, 60g sugar and 220ml water into a dough. Steam for 20 minutes, then knead smooth on a cornflour-dusted bench. Divide into 8, wrap each around a ball of red bean paste and dust with cornflour.

d.how: Simmer 1L water with a 4cm piece of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then let it cool to about 80C. Add 4 tsp sencha and steep for 1 minute only, then strain. Stir in 2 tbsp honey and a squeeze of lemon. Pour into small cups, or cool completely and serve over ice with a thin slice of lemon.
